rules.condition: decision_record_id differs from the frozen GOVDEC2 ID
governance_transaction_hash differs from the frozen hash
scope ID, ordered raw IDs, cardinality, or uniqueness differs from the 24 frozen IDs
authority_id or any identity basis field is absent
identity preimage cannot be recomputed to one sha256 authority ID
floating_reference_allowed is true or immutable identifier/digest is absent
evidence candidate, policy ID, authority ID, or digest does not match
identity procedure or canonicalization profile is not the specified V1 procedure
closed-object schema rejects an unknown key
same replay key or authority ID is reused with a changed hash/preimage/policy
candidate status is stale, revoked, superseded, or conflicts with a newer root
evidence set names more than one candidate authority
governance decision materialization asserts a source authority prerequisite
record requests acquisition, source-auth execution, Stage A/B, pins, operative records, P0, P1, or benchmark
